Samantha — thanks, this is great. Short answer up front: we can support both marketplace-managed procurement and direct Coupa-style POs, but the activation path and required docs differ slightly depending on the marketplace. Below is a consolidated checklist and the routing we typically follow.

Checklist (what we need from CloudFabrik to start):
- Legal vendor name + Tax ID / EIN (for the W-9)
- Completed vendor intake form (link below)
- Signed W-9 (US sellers) or equivalent tax form for non-US entities
- Bank details / ACH or wire instructions (for payouts)
- Current SOC 2 Type II report or our vendor questionnaire answers if SOC2 not available
- Point of contact for billing and legal & desired payment terms (Net 30, Net 45, etc.)

Procurement routing options:
1) AWS/Azure/GCP Marketplace (marketplace-managed): Redwood lists the product; marketplace handles purchase records and payouts. Minimal PO friction from end customers but requires an MPA and marketplace listing paperwork.
2) Direct PO to Redwood (Coupa/Ariba/etc.): Procurement issues PO to Redwood; we route invoice via our billing team. This path requires billing activation and is slightly longer (finance vendor creation + tax verification).

Timelines (typical):
- Vendor intake + W-9 + bank details: 2–4 business days to onboard in finance
- SOC2 / evidence review: 3–7 business days depending on scope
- Marketplace listing activation (once legal paperwork done): 5–10 business days due to marketplace review

Next steps for us: attach Redwood vendor packet, please return completed forms + signed W-9. Vanessa (cc'd) will handle billing activation once we have the financial docs. I will open the HubSpot deal and start the vendor intake.

Links / attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_v3.docx (attachment), Vendor intake form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-vendor-intake, DocuSign (MPA): https://app.docusign.com/MPA-CF-3489

If you send the signed W-9 and bank stub I can move this to billing this afternoon.

—Naomi

> Quick note from the sales side — if CloudFabrik plans to go live on AWS Marketplace...

Thanks — Vanessa here (billing ops). We can accept both marketplace remittances and direct POs. Notes:
- Marketplace payouts are handled by the marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure). We just need the seller linkage + MPA executed.
- For direct POs we require a vendor creation ticket (finance), completed W-9, and bank details. POs should include the Redwood vendor number once created to prevent delays.
- Standard payment terms are Net 30. Exceptions (Net 45 or special SLAs) need finance approval and can add 5–7 business days.

I will queue a billing activation ticket as soon as Naomi drops the signed W-9 + banking stub.
